info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Operational Actions Management API
info.description: The Operational Actions Management API facilitates the execution of advanced operational commands related to voice services in a banking context. This API enables authorized users to initiate various operational tasks, enhancing the management and efficiency of voice channel services. It is particularly useful for system administrators and operational teams who require precise control over voice service operations. With capabilities to streamline responses and manage transactions, this API supports efficient service delivery in financial environments.

post.summary: Create an operational action for advanced voice services.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new operational action that can be applied to advanced voice services operations within the specified channel-specific settings. It requires authentication and appropriate permissions to execute successfully.

requestBody.description: The request body for initiating operations on advanced voice services. This should contain necessary parameters specific to the operational actions intended for the channel. Please ensure all fields are provided as specified in the schema.
